name: Fourth Bridge Prowler — "you may have target creature get -1/-1" hits only the target
notes: Memory: project_behavioural_audit_and_controller_restrictions_2026-10-11. A fired "you may have target X get/gain/lose …" was parsed with the target as part of a global filter, so every creature got -1/-1. _addAbilityPseudo now rewrites it to "target X gets …" before parsing. The Bears are targeted and become 1/1; the Runeclaw Bear stays 2/2.
